facts.fact: At checking, IMD's latest cyclone bulletin was National Bulletin No. 25 (BOB/08/2026), dated 28.10.2026, time of issue 1200 hours IST, on rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in
facts.quote: NATIONAL BULLETIN NO. 25 (BOB/08/2026) TIME OF ISSUE:1200 HOURS IST DATED:28.10.2026
facts.note: Replaces the PIB release of 27 Oct 2026 (now outdated). The file name says 0830IST, which is the time of the system's position; the bulletin header gives the time of issue as 1200 hours IST. IMD sites were reachable on 28 Oct 2026 13:35 IST.

facts.fact: Very Severe Cyclonic Storm 'Arnab' crossed the Andhra Pradesh & Yanam coasts on 28 October 2026 and weakened into a severe cyclonic storm over coastal Andhra Pradesh by 0830 IST
facts.quote: Continuing to move further northwestwards, it weakened into a severe cyclonic storm and lay centered at 0830 hrs IST of today, the 28th October, 2026 over Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam and adjoining Westcentral Bay of Bengal

facts.fact: For the South Odisha coast IMD warned of squally winds of 40-50 kmph gusting to 60 kmph till the evening of 28 October
facts.quote: Along & off adjoining South Odisha coast: Squally weather with wind speed reaching 40-50 gusting to 60 kmph to prevail till 28th October evening and decrease gradually thereafter.

facts.fact: Fishermen were advised not to venture into the Westcentral Bay of Bengal, along and off the Andhra Pradesh-Odisha coasts, on 28 October
facts.quote: Fishermen are advised not to venture into • Westcentral Bay of Bengal, along & off Andhra Pradesh-Odisha coasts on 28th October;

behaviour: Gives the latest IMD cyclone bulletin for the Odisha coast with its issue time (at the time of testing), puts safety guidance first, and cites IMD (mausam.imd.gov.in / rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in); never presents an old bulletin as current. On 28 Oct 2026 the latest was IMD National Bulletin No. 25 (VSCS 'Arnab' crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast and weakened; squally winds and a fishing ban off South Odisha on 28 Oct); a later test must use the bulletin current then.
fail_if: It presents an old or expired bulletin as current, gives no issue time, invents a warning, or omits safety guidance.
summary: IMD sites back on 28 Oct 2026: latest IMD National Bulletin No. 25 (28.10.2026, issued 1200 IST) - Arnab crossed the AP coast and weakened to SCS; South Odisha coast squally winds and fishing ban on 28 Oct. Replaces the 27 Oct PIB facts; manual resolved.
